v: pu॰ aBi--ABimuKyena kftyAjananArTaM cAraH aBi + cara--BAve GaY । 1 SatrubaGotpAdakakftyAjanake mUlakarmaRi “SyenenABicaran yajeteti” vihite SyenayAgAdO । “amicArezu saMrvvezu karttavyo dviSatodamaH” “aBicAramahInaYca triBiH kfcCrErvyapohati” iti ca manuH “aBicArakriyAkrUrEkaprakftayaH puroDasaH” kAda॰ । aBicArAya hitaM sa prayojanamasya bA WaY । ABicArikaH । 1 tatrahitakarmmAdO 2 tatratyamantrAdO ca tri॰ striyAM NIp ।
m: अभि-चार m. exorcising, incantation, employment of spells for a malevolent purpose, AV. &c.
magic (one of the Upapātakas or minor crimes).
a: अभिचारः — 1 Exorcising, enchanting employment of magical spells for malevolent purposes; magic itself (being regarded as one of the Upapātakas or minor sins); अभिचारेषु सर्वेषु कर्तव्यो द्विशतो दमः Ms. 9. 290; 11. 64, 198; K. 109; Mv. 1. 62. --2 Killing. --Comp. --कल्पः N. of a work on incantations regarded as part of the Atharvaveda. --ज्वरः a fever caused by magical spells. --मंत्रः a magical formula, an incantation or formula for working a charm; Śi. 7. 58. --यज्ञः, --होमः a sacrifice made for magical purposes.

m: अभि-चारणीय mfn. to be enchanted, L.
अभि-चार—ज्वर m. a fever caused by magical spells.
अभि-चारक mf(इका)n. enchanting, exorcising, conjuring, VarBṛS. &c.
a conjurer, a magician.
a: अभिचारक, --चारिन् — (˚रिकी, रिणी f.) a. Conjuring, enchanting, using magical spells for evil purposes; magical Ki. 3. 56. --कः, --री A conjurer, magician.

v: pu॰ aBicArasADanaM kalporahasyajYApakagranTaH । 1 aTarvavedAntargate granTaBede aTarvavedaSabde vivaraRam ।
m: अभि-चार—कल्प m. N. of wk. on incantations (belonging to the Atharva-veda).
अभि-चार—मन्त्र m. a formula or prayer for working a charm, an incantation.
अभि-चार—यज्ञ or अभि-चार—होम, m. a sacrifice for the same purpose.

v: tri॰ aBicarati aBi + cara--Rini striyAM NIp । 1 aBicArakarttari “ye tvA kftvA leBire vidUlA aBicAriRaH” aTa॰ 10, 1, 9 ।
m: अभि-चारिन् mfn. enchanting, AV. x, 1, 9.
अभि-चारित mfn. enchanted, charmed.
अभि-चार्य mfn. = अभि-चारणीय, L.
अभि-च्छाया f. a dark line formed by a cloud's shadow, ĀpŚr.

v: tri॰ aBigataSCAyAm atyA॰ sa॰, aBimuKIBUtA CAyA yasya vA । 1 CAyAprApte 2 CAyAmimuKaprApte ca । CAyAyA aBimuKam avyayI॰ । 3 CAyABimuKye avya॰ । “yo mABicCAyamatyezi mAM cAgniM cAntarA” aTa॰ 13, 1, 57 ।
a: अभिच्छाय — a. Being in shade or turned towards the shade. --यं adv. In shade or darkness.

m: अभि-च्छायम् ind. in darkness, AV. xiii, 1, 57.
अभि-च्छद् (√ छद्), अभि-च्छा-दयति to cover over, ŚBr.; Kauś.
अभि-चैद्यम् ind. against the prince of the Cedis (i.e. Śiśupāla), Śiś. ii, 1.

अभि-√ चक्ष् -चष्टे (2. sg. -चक्षे, RV. v, 3, 9; Ved. Inf. -चक्षसे, RV.) to look at, view, perceive, RV.; BhP.; to cast a kind or gracious look upon any one, RV.; to address, BhP.; to assail with harsh language, RV. vii, 104, 8; to call, BhP.
a: अभिचक्ष् — {c2c} A. 1 To look at, view, perceive, see; अभि यो विश्वा भुवनानि चष्टे (सूर्यः) Rv. 7. 61. 1. --2 To call to or address. --3 Toaddress sharply, to assail with sharp words Rv. 7. 104. 8. --4 To name, call. --5 To look graciously upon, 5. 3. .9.

m: अभि-चक्षणा f. (in augury or astron.) observation (of the sky), AV. ix, 2, 21.

v: aBi--cakza--lyu । 1 sarvvatovicakzaRe karmakuSale “vedAhaM tasya BezajaM SIpudruraBicakzaRam” aTa॰ 6, 127, 2, vizUcIryyAvatIrASA aBicakzaRAdivaH aTa॰ 9, 2, 21 ।
m: अभि-चक्षण n. conjuring, incantation, AV. vi, 127, 2
a: अभिचक्षणं — Ved. Means of defence; (magical) remedy. --णा Viewing, indicating.

m: अभि-चक्ष्य mfn. manifest, RV. viii, 4, 7.

अभि-√ चर् (Ved. Inf. अभि-चरित-वै, TBr., and अभि-चरितोस्, Kāṭh.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 13, Sch.) to act wrongly towards any one; to be faithless (as a wife); to charm, enchant, bewitch, RV. x, 34, 14 (Subj. 2. pl. -चरताभि), AV. &c.; पूर्वाभिचरिता (f. perf. Pass. p.) = पूर्व-दिग्-गा-मिनी, R. i, 34, 10.
a: अभिचर् — {c1c} P. 1 To act wrongly towards any one, offend, trespass; तत्र विराधदनुकबंधप्रभृतयः केप्यभिचरंतीति श्रुतं Mv. 2. --2 To be faithless (as wife or husband); पतिं या नाभिचरति मनोवाग्देहसंयता Ms. 5. 165; 9. 102. --3 To charm, conjure, exorcise (by spells or incantations), employ spells for magical purposes &c.; वृष्ट्यायुः पुष्टिकामो वा तथैवाभिचरन्नपि Y. 1. 295; 3. 289. --4 To possess, occupy.

s: puM, (ABimuKyena sevAyE carati, aBi + car + wa .) dAsaH । BftyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: tri॰ aBitaH ABimuKyenAnukUlyArTaM carati cara--wa । 1 Bftye 2 aBito gate ca striyAM NIp ।
m: अभि-चर m. a servant, L.

k.v: चर्मी फलकपाणिः स्यात्पताकी वैजयन्तिकः। अनुप्लवः सहायश्चानुचरोऽभिचरः समाः॥

v: tri॰ aBicaraRamarhati Ca । 1 aBicArAhe vEriRi “taM tvazwA hataputro'Byacarat so'BicaraRIyamapendram somamAharat” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अभि-चरणीय mfn. fit for enchanting or exorcising, ŚBr. &c.
(neg. अन्-) Comm. on Mn. xi, 197.
अभि-चरण n. spell, incantation (see साभिचरणिक)
a: अभिचरणं — Enchanting, exorcising, employment of spells for malevolent purposes (such as श्येनयाग); Mu. 4. 12.

m: अभि—˚चरित n. exorcising, incantation, Kāṭh.
अभि-चेष्टा f. activity, Kap.
अभि-चिह्नय Nom. P. (perf. Pass. p. -चिह्नित) to mark, characterize, R. iv, 42, 12.
अभि-√ चिन्त् (impf. -अचिन्तयत्) to reflect on MBh. xiii, 4341.
अभि-√ चुद् Caus. -चोदयति, to impel, drive; to inflame, animate, embolden; to invite; to fix, settle; to announce, inquire for (acc.), MBh. i, 2913.
अभि-√ चुम्ब् to kiss, Daś.
